tests.name: Public signup disabled and anonymous login disabled in actual Auth configuration
Real administrator password login validates getUser and DB membership, wrong password rejected
Actual refresh rotates a valid session; logout rejects its refresh token
Anonymous and forged JWT cannot call admin RPC, ordinary authenticated user cannot self-promote
Even a real admin JWT has no direct private-table REST access
Downgrading DB role applies immediately to existing JWT without token refresh
Private and restricted file uploads, reads and signed URL denial use actual Storage
Disabled member JWT loses all admin APIs and restricted bytes immediately
Real recovery token opens password form, clears URL secrets and submits password through Auth
Actual recovery email and PKCE code exchange complete in the same browser
Missing, expired and forged callback parameters show failure, never expose admin shell
Deleting Auth user cascades membership; cached JWT no longer authorizes data
